info.title: AntCode Commando - E-Commerce Logistics API
info.description: Order lookups over the customer_neighborhood/delivery_status composite index, and a single idempotent /webhook/{provider} payment callback shared by MTN MoMo, Orange Money, Campay, Smobilpay, and GeniusPay.

providerSignature.name: X-Provider-Signature
providerSignature.description: Placeholder name for whichever signature header the {provider} path segment actually expects, resolved dynamically from _PROVIDER_CONFIG (app/routes/webhooks.py): momo -> X-Momo-Signature/MOMO_WEBHOOK_SECRET, orange -> X-Orange-Signature/ORANGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, campay -> X-Campay-Signature/CAMPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, smobilpay -> X-Smobilpay-Signature/SMOBILPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, geniuspay -> X-Webhook-Signature/GENIUSPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET. All of them are a hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body except geniuspay, which signs f"{X-Webhook-Timestamp}.{raw_request_body}" instead (also requires the X-Webhook-Timestamp and X-Webhook-Event headers).

StandardProviderCallback.description: Flat callback shape shared by momo, orange, campay, and smobilpay.

GeniusPayCallback.description: The outcome (paid vs. failed) is carried by the X-Webhook-Event header (payment.success / payment.failed), not a body field.

WebhookCallback.description: Body shape depends on which provider the {provider} path segment names: momo/orange/campay/smobilpay send the flat StandardProviderCallback shape, geniuspay sends the nested GeniusPayCallback shape.

get.summary: List orders, optionally filtered by neighborhood and/or delivery status
get.description: Backed by idx_orders_neighborhood_status: a neighborhood-only filter uses the index's leading column, neighborhood+status uses the full composite seek.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-indexed page number. Defaults to 1; clamped to 1 if lower or non-numeric.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page. Defaults to 20; clamped to 1 if lower or non-numeric.

get.summary: Fetch a single order by its internal id

post.summary: Payment callback for the named provider
post.description: Single dynamic entry point for every provider's payment callback -- momo, orange, campay, smobilpay, and geniuspay. _webhook() (app/routes/webhooks.py) resolves that provider's own secret, signature header, and (geniuspay only) timestamp/event headers from _PROVIDER_CONFIG. Idempotent, keyed on (provider, external_transaction_id): replaying the same transaction id (e.g. after an MTN retry following a 3G timeout in Douala/Yaounde) returns already_processed instead of double-charging the order. For geniuspay, order_id is read from data.metadata.order_id, the order is marked Paid only when X-Webhook-Event is payment.success, and a webhook.test event is acknowledged without touching orders. Adding a new provider only means adding an entry to _PROVIDER_CONFIG -- not a new route.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Which payment provider sent this callback. Any value with no entry in _PROVIDER_CONFIG returns 500.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Timestamp
parameters.description: geniuspay only: Unix timestamp GeniusPay signed alongside the body; part of the HMAC message.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Event
parameters.description: geniuspay only: event type. payment.success marks the order Paid; webhook.test is acknowledged without touching orders; anything else leaves it unpaid.

200.description: Processed, already processed (idempotent replay), or a geniuspay webhook.test acknowledgement

401.description: Missing, invalid, or payload/timestamp-mismatched signature for the named provider

500.description: provider names a value with no entry in _PROVIDER_CONFIG (misconfiguration)
